test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All curtain are screen.

All curtain are blinder.

Some blinder are drape.

Conclusions:

(I) Some drape are curtain.

(II) Some blinder are screen.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ba7732388f1d067638837de98b0f4528963572f276d92609c6c263bdf6beea2.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some drape are curtain → Does not follow (As all curtain are blinder and some blinder are drape. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) Some blinder are screen → Follow (As all curtain are screen and all curtain are blinder. As whole curtains comes in both screen and binder, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
